rules.consensus: A call is shared by the set when every video that could be read has it, or all but one when at least three could be read.
rules.theme: A theme is agreed on when every video that takes a side on it takes the same one and at least two do; mostly, when one video dissents from at least three; split, otherwise.
rules.odd: A video stands apart when its lean is at least 0.5 from the median of the others, a quarter of the scale, and its own 95% interval does not include that median. Only videos with enough comments, or enough of the words read, take part.
rules.period: A change between two periods is called only when their ranges do not overlap. Otherwise it is within the spread.

verdict.text: Across 4 videos, the reviewers' words lean positive in 3 and are balanced in 1; the audiences lean positive in 3 and are balanced in 1. By theme, they agree on design and build (praised), performance and features (praised), price and value (praised), camera and photography (praised) and battery and charging (praised); they split on materials and durability.

consensus_words.text: Reviewers agree on Design and Build (praised in 3 of 3), Performance and Features (praised in 3 of 3), Price and Value (praised in 2 of 3), Camera and Photography (praised in 2 of 2) and Battery and Charging (praised in 2 of 2).

split_words.text: Reviewers split on Materials and Durability (praised in 1, criticised in 1).

brand_health_words.text: Across 400 comments on 4 videos, 230 read positive, 118 neutral and 52 negative.

agreement_words.text: Of 4 videos, the audience is measurably warmer than the reviewer in 3 and there is no clear difference in 1.
